company_profile.summary: Polycab India Ltd is India's largest manufacturer of wires and cables and a fast-growing player in Fast Moving Electrical Goods (FMEG). Commanding over 24% organized market share in domestic cables and wires, Polycab delivers essential electrical infrastructure across power transmission, green energy projects, telecom optical fiber, and residential construction.

revenue_breakup.desc: Low-voltage, medium-voltage, and extra-high-voltage power cables, control cables, and building wires.
Fans, LED lighting, switches, switchgear, solar inverters, and water heaters.
Power distribution EPC, rural electrification, and high-speed BharatNet optical fiber connectivity.

company_profile.geographic_mix: Domestic (India): 91% • International Exports (USA, Australia, Middle East, Europe): 9%
moats_and_strengths: Dominant market leadership in Indian cables & wires with over 24% organized market share.
Unrivalled distribution moat with 4,300+ authorized dealers and over 205,000 retail touchpoints across India.
High backward integration manufacturing copper rods, aluminum wire rods, PVC/XLPE compounds, and GI wire.
Strong balance sheet with net cash position, low working capital cycle, and high ROCE (>28%).
company_profile.order_book_or_capacity: Manufacturing Facilities: 25+ state-of-the-art plants across Gujarat, Maharashtra, and Roorkee

bullish_triggers: Multi-billion dollar capex upcycle in India's power transmission, real estate, and industrial manufacturing.
Rapid international export expansion to the US and Australia replacing Chinese cable suppliers.
EBITDA margin expansion in FMEG appliances as brand maturity and scale efficiencies take hold.
bearish_risks: Sharp spikes in global copper and aluminum LME commodity prices requiring frequent price adjustments.
Intensifying competition in premium consumer building wires from Havells, KEI, and RR Kabel.
